title: csv.write raises MemoryError when resizing the main window
body:
Environment

Running Lattice 3.2.8 on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS against ap-
south-1.

Steps

How to trigger it:
* Start by resizing the main window.
* Choose a date range covering over two years.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

Expected

Expected resizing the main window to finish without errors.

Actual

Memory climbs to several gigabytes within a minute and then
it fails. A large export spanning over two years triggers
it; smaller ranges work.

Frequency

Reproduces every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:210 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:59 in tiles
lattice/report/csv.py:123 in write
MemoryError: unable to allocate 1.5 GiB for export buffer
